headline: Upgrade Your RV
title: RV Level 2 Upgrade | Do This After Day One | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Your Homeland stalls until you upgrade the R V. To reach R V level two, finish the quest called The Wondrous R V and place four farmland plots in your Home. The upgrade gives you more room for Aniimo and more storage, so you can run more workers. It also runs on a countdown after you start it, so begin it before you log off. What is your R V level? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Start it before you log off

description: How to unlock RV Level 2 in Aniimo's Homeland: complete The Wondrous RV quest and place four farmland plots, unlocking more Aniimo slots and storage; the upgrade runs on a countdown.
